name: Collapsible Can Cooler w/ Carabiner
description: These collapsible can coolers made of durable yet flexible neoprene fold quickly and easily and will keep beverages cooler longer. Features a carabiner buckle that allows you to clip it to your bag or anything else! The koolies are available in a large selection of vibrant colors! This classic item is great for tailgating parties or for company picnics! Customize with an imprint to further tailor to your next event.
